about.en: AEON is the token of AEON (aeon.xyz), a crypto payment and settlement network that lets users and AI agents pay merchants with digital assets through scan-to-pay and cross-chain settlement. AEON is a BNB Smart Chain BEP-20 token at 0x277aDD739c6E0477616948357AF9E79Fe1Ec9B80 with 8 decimals and a 1,000,000,000 total supply. It is unrelated to the older Aeon (AEON) privacy coin.
